Business definition: BTS scheduled segment rows in context, including cancellations and diversions.
Calculation: COUNTROWS ( FactFlight )

Business definition: Rows with the BTS cancellation flag equal to 0, including diversions.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[Cancelled] = 0 ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Non-cancelled and non-diverted rows, including any missing arrival delay.
Calculation: [Non-Cancelled Flights] - [Diverted Flights]

Business definition: Completed rows with observed signed arrival delay.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[ArrivalOutcome] IN { "On time", "Delayed 15+" } ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Comparable arrivals with signed delay below 15 minutes.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[ArrivalOutcome] = "On time" ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Comparable arrivals with signed delay at or above 15 minutes.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[ArrivalOutcome] = "Delayed 15+" ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Non-cancelled rows with observed signed departure delay. Diversions can qualify.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[DepartureOutcome] IN { "On time", "Delayed 15+" } ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Comparable departures with signed delay below 15 minutes.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[DepartureOutcome] = "On time" ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Comparable departures with signed delay at or above 15 minutes.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[DepartureOutcome] = "Delayed 15+" ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Rows with the BTS cancellation flag equal to 1.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[Cancelled] = 1 ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Rows with the BTS diversion flag equal to 1.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[Diverted] = 1 ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Completed rows missing signed arrival delay.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[ArrivalOutcome] = "Missing arrival delay" ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Non-cancelled rows missing signed departure delay.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[DepartureOutcome] = "Missing departure delay" ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Comparable arrivals at least 60 minutes late. Portfolio severity threshold.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[ArrivalOutcome] = "Delayed 15+" ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[ArrivalDelay] >= 60 ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Delayed arrivals with at least one reported nonblank cause-minute field.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[HasReportedCause] = TRUE () ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Arrival OTP using BTS's cutoff and a comparable-arrival denominator.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [On-Time Arrivals], [Comparable Arrivals] )

Business definition: Share of comparable arrivals at least 15 minutes late.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [Delayed Arrivals], [Comparable Arrivals] )

Business definition: Departure OTP using the same cutoff, with departure-specific eligibility.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [On-Time Departures], [Comparable Departures] )

Business definition: Share of comparable departures at least 15 minutes late.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [Delayed Departures], [Comparable Departures] )

Business definition: Share of all scheduled records that were cancelled.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [Cancelled Flights], [Scheduled Flights] )

Business definition: Share of all scheduled records that were diverted.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [Diverted Flights], [Scheduled Flights] )

Business definition: Share of all scheduled records that were neither cancelled nor diverted.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [Completed Flights], [Scheduled Flights] )

Business definition: Share of comparable arrivals at least 60 minutes late.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [Flights Delayed 60+ Minutes], [Comparable Arrivals] )

Business definition: Share of 15+ late arrivals with any reported cause-minute field.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [Late Arrivals With Reported Cause], [Delayed Arrivals] )

Business definition: Sum of the signed arrival delay on comparable arrivals at least 15 minutes late.
Calculation: IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( [Scheduled Flights] ), COALESCE ( CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactFlight[ArrivalDelay] ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[ArrivalOutcome] = "Delayed 15+" ) ), 0 ) )

Business definition: Mean delay severity on arrivals at least 15 minutes late.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [Arrival Delay Minutes 15+], [Delayed Arrivals] )

Business definition: Average signed delay on comparable arrivals. Early values remain negative.
Calculation: CALCULATE ( AVERAGE ( FactFlight[ArrivalDelay] ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[ArrivalOutcome] IN { "On time", "Delayed 15+" } ) )

Business definition: Sums the selected BTS attribution fields on eligible late arrivals. Totals add the five cause groups.
Calculation: CALCULATE ( SUMX ( VALUES ( DimDelayCause[Cause] ), SWITCH ( DimDelayCause[Cause], "Air carrier", CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactFlight[CarrierDelay] ) ), "Weather", CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactFlight[WeatherDelay] ) ), "National Aviation System", CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactFlight[NASDelay] ) ), "Security", CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactFlight[SecurityDelay] ) ), "Late-arriving aircraft", CALCULATE ( SUM ( FactFlight[LateAircraftDelay] ) ) ) ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactFlight[ArrivalOutcome] = "Delayed 15+" ) )

Business definition: Selected cause minutes divided by all reported cause minutes in the same operational context.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [Reported Cause Minutes], CALCULATE ( [Reported Cause Minutes], ALL ( DimDelayCause ) ) )

Business definition: Cancellations in the selected reason divided by all cancellations in the same operational context.
Calculation: IF ( [Cancelled Flights] > 0, DIVIDE ( [Cancelled Flights], CALCULATE ( [Cancelled Flights], ALL ( DimCancellation ) ) ) )

Business definition: Weighted on-time rate with all permitted carriers, retaining date and geography. RLS still applies.
Calculation: CALCULATE ( [On-Time Arrival %], ALL ( DimCarrier ) )

Business definition: Carrier OTP minus weighted network OTP in percentage points.
Calculation: VAR Actual = [On-Time Arrival %] VAR Network = [Network On-Time Arrival %] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( Actual ) && NOT ISBLANK ( Network ), 100 * ( Actual - Network ) )

Business definition: Flight-volume share within the carriers selected outside the current visual row.
Calculation: DIVIDE ( [Scheduled Flights], CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], ALLSELECTED ( DimCarrier ) ) )

Business definition: Dense descending OTP rank among selected, eligible carriers. Minimum 1,000 comparable arrivals. Rates round to six decimal places for rank ties.
Calculation: VAR MinimumArrivals = 1000 VAR Peers = FILTER ( ALLSELECTED ( DimCarrier[Carrier] ), [Comparable Arrivals] >= MinimumArrivals ) RETURN IF ( ISINSCOPE ( DimCarrier[Carrier] ) && [Comparable Arrivals] >= MinimumArrivals, RANKX ( Peers, ROUND ( [On-Time Arrival %], 6 ), , DESC, DENSE ) )

Business definition: Dense descending delay-minute rank among selected directional routes with at least 500 comparable arrivals.
Calculation: VAR MinimumArrivals = 500 VAR Routes = FILTER ( ALLSELECTED ( DimRoute[Route] ), [Comparable Arrivals] >= MinimumArrivals ) RETURN IF ( ISINSCOPE ( DimRoute[Route] ) && [Comparable Arrivals] >= MinimumArrivals, RANKX ( Routes, [Arrival Delay Minutes 15+], , DESC, DENSE ) )

Business definition: Reported year-to-date scheduled flights, shown only in single-year context with source coverage.
Calculation: IF ( HASONEVALUE ( DimDate[Year] ) && CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimDate ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimDate[IsInScope] = TRUE () ) ) > 0, CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], DATESYTD ( DimDate[Date] ) ) )

Business definition: Weighted reported year-to-date arrival OTP, shown only in single-year context with source coverage.
Calculation: IF ( HASONEVALUE ( DimDate[Year] ) && CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( DimDate ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimDate[IsInScope] = TRUE () ) ) > 0, CALCULATE ( [On-Time Arrival %], DATESYTD ( DimDate[Date] ) ) )

Business definition: Prior-year scheduled flights for exactly matched covered day/month pairs.
Calculation: VAR CoveredDates = CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( DimDate[Date] ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimDate[IsInScope] = TRUE () ) ) VAR MatchedDates = FILTER ( CoveredDates, VAR ThisDate = DimDate[Date] VAR PriorDate = EDATE ( ThisDate, -12 ) RETURN DAY ( ThisDate ) = DAY ( PriorDate ) && CONTAINS ( ALL ( DimDate ), DimDate[Date], PriorDate, DimDate[IsInScope], TRUE () ) ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [Scheduled Flights], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), TREATAS ( SELECTCOLUMNS ( MatchedDates, "PriorDate", EDATE ( DimDate[Date], -12 ) ), DimDate[Date] ) )

Business definition: Prior-year weighted OTP for exactly matched covered day/month pairs.
Calculation: VAR CoveredDates = CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( DimDate[Date] ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimDate[IsInScope] = TRUE () ) ) VAR MatchedDates = FILTER ( CoveredDates, VAR ThisDate = DimDate[Date] VAR PriorDate = EDATE ( ThisDate, -12 ) RETURN DAY ( ThisDate ) = DAY ( PriorDate ) && CONTAINS ( ALL ( DimDate ), DimDate[Date], PriorDate, DimDate[IsInScope], TRUE () ) ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [On-Time Arrival %], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), TREATAS ( SELECTCOLUMNS ( MatchedDates, "PriorDate", EDATE ( DimDate[Date], -12 ) ), DimDate[Date] ) )

Business definition: Weighted OTP over current dates with covered prior-year matches.
Calculation: VAR CoveredDates = CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( DimDate[Date] ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimDate[IsInScope] = TRUE () ) ) VAR MatchedDates = FILTER ( CoveredDates, VAR ThisDate = DimDate[Date] VAR PriorDate = EDATE ( ThisDate, -12 ) RETURN DAY ( ThisDate ) = DAY ( PriorDate ) && CONTAINS ( ALL ( DimDate ), DimDate[Date], PriorDate, DimDate[IsInScope], TRUE () ) ) RETURN CALCULATE ( [On-Time Arrival %], REMOVEFILTERS ( DimDate ), TREATAS ( MatchedDates, DimDate[Date] ) )

Business definition: Current matched-date OTP minus prior matched-date OTP, in percentage points. Feb 29 is excluded if unpaired.
Calculation: VAR Actual = [On-Time Arrival % Current Matched] VAR Prior = [On-Time Arrival % LY Matched] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( Actual ) && NOT ISBLANK ( Prior ), 100 * ( Actual - Prior ) )

Business definition: Lists the covered months in the current context.
Calculation: VAR Months = CALCULATETABLE ( VALUES ( DimDate[Year Month] ), KEEPFILTERS ( DimDate[IsInScope] = TRUE () ) ) RETURN IF ( ISEMPTY ( Months ), "No covered dates", CONCATENATEX ( Months, DimDate[Year Month], " · ", DimDate[Year Month], ASC ) )

Calculation: "Arrival reliability | " & [Selected Period]

Calculation: "Carrier comparison | " & [Selected Period]

Calculation: "Directional routes | " & [Selected Period]

Calculation: "Reported delay attribution | " & [Selected Period]

Calculation: "Flight records | " & SELECTEDVALUE ( DimRoute[Route], "Select a route" )
